source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Carrying fairly little established role in the ongoing management of a client's asthma symptoms","B":"Directly relaxing airway smooth muscle through stimulation of beta receptors within the lungs","C":"Blocking leukotriene receptors, reducing inflammation and bronchoconstriction associated with the leukotriene pathway","D":"Providing rapid rescue relief during an acute asthma attack, similar to how a short-acting bronchodilator works"}}
source_row.rationale: Montelukast works by blocking leukotriene receptors, reducing inflammation and bronchoconstriction associated with the leukotriene pathway, used as a maintenance therapy option rather than for rapid rescue relief during acute symptoms.
